nodes.g: to be marvellous, be wonderful, be surpassing, be extraordinary, separate by…
nodes.bdb: to be marvellous, be wonderful, be surpassing, be extraordinary, separate by distinguishing action
nodes.klein: to distinguish, make special (said of a vow). it occurs only in the Bible in the phrase לְפַלֵּא נֶדֶר, Lev. 22:21 and Num. 15:3 and 8 (= to make a special vow). in this sense it occurs only in the Bible in the phrase יַפְלִיא נֶדֶר, Lev. 27:2, and יַפְלִא לִנְדֹּר נֶדֶר, Num. 6:2 (= he makes a special vow).

nodes.g: to be distinct, marked out, be separated, be distinguished
to swallow down, swallow up, engulf, eat up
